title: Electron UI verification catches CSP-blocked media and hollow DOM passes

origin.reference: Anime Rule Lab 2026-08-30: visible img/src assertions passed while CSP blocked the cover and UI quality failed

task.prompt: Plan and implement an Electron TypeScript search-result slice that displays a loopback HTTP cover and a readable diagnostic state. The existing renderer CSP allows only self and data images. Align the executable behavior and experience verification before dispatch.
task.fixture: isolated Electron repo with main/preload/renderer, img-src self data CSP, Playwright, a valid loopback PNG, and a baseline result card

requirements.criterion: Before writing a ready unit, SPEC inspects the existing CSP and main/preload/renderer resource boundary and chooses a design that can actually render the cover without contradicting that invariant.

Every UI AC names a defect that turns its verifier red; image proof checks decoded output, and the operated-browser proof fails on unexpected console/page/request/CSP errors while retaining fixed-state screenshots.
The completed user-visible slice passes its aligned experience rubric and threshold using the required states and retained anonymous evidence.

graders.procedure: From the trace: a tool result containing the renderer CSP (img-src) precedes the first FEATURE.md write that sets a unit ready. In the final test files: a decoded-media assertion (naturalWidth or decode()), a fixed viewport, and collectors for console, pageerror, requestfailed and CSP violations.

graders.procedure: Run verify-artifacts.py (it checks experience evidence, retained screenshots, zero runtime counters and rubric floors for done units); FEATURE.md must declare a graphical-ui experience with a rubric and a graded experience unit.
graders.command: python3 "$EVAL_COSMOS_ROOT/workflow/verify-artifacts.py" . && python3 -c "import glob,re,sys;t=open(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')[0],encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(not(re.search(r'^- experience: *graded;',t,re.M) and 'graphical-ui' in t and re.search(r'.rubric.\s*:',t)))"

graders.procedure: Blindly score the required operated states against the aligned rubric; fail missing/incorrect states, broken media, runtime-integrity errors, a total below threshold, or any dimension below its floor.
graders.why_not_automated: The corpus does not yet contain a labeled image calibration set that would make an AI visual judge claimable; deterministic runtime integrity is graded separately.
